requiredFindings.location: PLAN-r1.md section 1 ResolverInputV1.release and section 3, line 84
requiredFindings.finding: The plan identifies the combined profiles/capability-availability input as NE ReleaseCapabilityRegistryV1. That accepted schema is an array of ReleaseCapabilityDeclarationV1 rows containing capabilityId and languageModes; it contains no profile IDs, default profile definition or profile membership registry. PCM instead expects an object with separate profiles/capabilities/packs/waivers. The proposed input therefore does not yet explain how profile admission can be implemented without inventing release content or extending the accepted capability schema.
requiredFindings.requiredChange: Distinguish the admitted capability-availability rows from the trusted profile/default inputs. Specify the host-internal typed interface and profile membership source under AQ/MB, or identify any remaining authority prerequisite. Preserve the accepted ReleaseCapabilityRegistryV1 shape and leave release-specific content/authentication to its owner.

requiredFindings.finding: The promised exhaustive refusal routing lists invalid compiled defaults and post-resolution semantic records as host invariants but omits invalid host-built FlagLayerV1. Its generic lexical/schema/allowlist/path categories otherwise route to CONFIG.INVALID. MB item 4 explicitly routes an invalid host-built flags document to the host-invariant row, and AQ section 1 requires invalid internal layers to be host faults. A typed flag layer can still contain an invalid empty workspaceRoots array or malformed logical path unless its type is specified to make that impossible.
requiredFindings.requiredChange: State the host-built flags admission invariant and its host-invariant routing explicitly, distinguish internal defaults/flags from external carriers at each applicable step, and add a negative control. Alternatively specify a validated flag type that proves these states impossible before the resolver, with an explicit host-invariant construction-failure path. Do not add a public code.

requiredFindings.finding: The digest control says flag-only selections leave the digest unchanged, without excluding the only M3 configuration flag, --workspace-root. Sections 1 and MB item 2 map that flag to discovery.workspaceRoots, a semantic leaf included in resolvedConfigDigest. Changing the winning roots from one valid nonempty set to another must change the digest; the current test instruction conflicts with its own semantic-leaf sensitivity rule.
requiredFindings.requiredChange: Limit flag invariance to the non-configuration selection/authorization/presentation flags excluded by MB item 6. Add an explicit --workspace-root sensitivity case, plus same-winning-value/provenance-only invariance, and keep allowedScopes order significant.
